confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors come from aggregated cost-of-living sites and a 2026 Yucatan cantina price guide, with mixed dates and small samples. Beer and cappuccino agree closely across sources. Meal anchors have wide spreads, so they are bounded estimates. Cocktail rests on cantina peso price tiers. Wine_glass has no direct per-glass source; it uses about 2.5x the beer anchor, with a store bottle price only as a reference. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge; no accommodation searches or live listings were checked. The FX observation (2026-11-18) comes from an RBA exchange-rates overview search result and was corroborated only by a third-party listing; the full F11.1 table was not retrieved, and an earlier cached RBA snapshot showed a stale value. Two RBA-directed searches were used, one more than allocated, within the six-search cap.
comparable_city_reasoning: Latin America regional basis for a mid-sized Mexican colonial tourist city. Food and drink anchors use Merida-specific aggregated sources (Numbeo, My Life Elsewhere, Expatistan, Where and When, World Travel Index, Combien Coute) and a 2026 Yucatan cantina price guide. Accommodation anchors use general regional knowledge of hostel and hotel tiers in comparable Mexican mid-sized cities.
